quarterly_data.signal: Quanta filed August 2026 consolidated net revenue of NT$423,970,932 thousand, up 177.45% from NT$152,807,846 thousand in August 2025; year-to-date revenue was NT$2,636,058,779 thousand, up 102.63% YoY. The filed reason for the change is a change in product mix.
